title: Reverse Engineering of the M-VAVE FM-1 Pocket Synthesizer Firmware
title_zh: M-VAVE FM-1 便携式合成器固件的逆向工程

paragraphs.en: Reverse Engineering of the M-VAVE FM-1 Pocket Synthesizer Firmware
paragraphs.zh: M-VAVE FM-1 便携式合成器固件逆向工程

paragraphs.en: Reverse engineering and update-protocol research for the M-Vave FM-1 synthesizer. Package, SPL, and SDK provenance identify the target as JieLi AC791N/WL82 with a pi32v2 CPU, XIP flash at 0x02000000 , and a Dexed/msfa-derived six-operator FM engine. The embedded JL-BR22 string is inherited library nomenclature, not reliable SoC identification.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 M-Vave FM-1 合成器的逆向工程与升级协议研究。 软件包、SPL 与 SDK 的来源信息表明目标平台为 JieLi AC791N/WL82，配备 pi32v2 CPU、位于 0x02000000 的 XIP 闪存，以及基于 Dexed/msfa 的六算子 FM 引擎。 固件中嵌入的 JL-BR22 字符串是继承自库的命名，并非可靠的 SoC 识别依据。

paragraphs.en: This main branch intentionally contains no replacement firmware or custom image builders. The former experimental implementation is preserved on the with-custom-firmware branch.
paragraphs.zh: 此主分支刻意不包含任何替换固件或自定义镜像构建器。 之前的实验性实现保留在 with-custom-firmware 分支上。

sents.en: The former experimental implementation is preserved on the with-custom-firmware branch.
sents.zh: 之前的实验性实现保留在 with-custom-firmware 分支上。

paragraphs.en: The repository retains two independently developed V13 analysis pipelines. analysis/README.md explains their roles. analysis/db.json and docs/function-index.md are the current classification outputs; analysis/function_db.json and analysis/master_index.json provide independent cross-validation and provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 该仓库保留了两个独立开发的 V13 分析流水线。analysis/README.md 说明了它们的作用。analysis/db.json 和 docs/function-index.md 是当前的分类输出；analysis/function_db.json 和 analysis/master_index.json 提供独立的交叉验证与来源追溯。

paragraphs.en: # Low-level disassembly and independent function map scripts/run_ghidra.sh python3 scripts/build_funcdb.py python3 scripts/resolve_strings.py python3 scripts/match_libs.py python3 scripts/build_master_index.py python3 scripts/build_slices.py # OTA loader extraction, vendor map, and corroborative Ghidra sweep scripts/analyze_ota_loader.sh scripts/run_ghidra_loader.sh # Current enriched classification database and documentation python3 scripts/build_db.py scripts/disasm_toolchain_libs.sh python3 scripts/match_libs.py python3 scripts/mech_tag.py python3 scripts/export_shards.py python3 scripts/aggregate.py # Offline OTA protocol checks python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -v Safety status The update protocol is not a demonstrated recovery mechanism. Current work has not established ROM recovery, rollback, or safe interrupted-write behavior for the single-bank layout. The console/factory-mode audit in analysis/device/debug-surfaces.md found no substitute recovery entry. Read TODO_aug2.md before using any update or flash utility.
paragraphs.zh: # 底层反汇编与独立函数映射 scripts/run_ghidra.sh python3 scripts/build_funcdb.py python3 scripts/resolve_strings.py python3 scripts/match_libs.py python3 scripts/build_master_index.py python3 scripts/build_slices.py # OTA 加载器提取、厂商映射与佐证性 Ghidra 扫描 scripts/analyze_ota_loader.sh scripts/run_ghidra_loader.sh # 当前的增强分类数据库与文档 python3 scripts/build_db.py scripts/disasm_toolchain_libs.sh python3 scripts/match_libs.py python3 scripts/mech_tag.py python3 scripts/export_shards.py python3 scripts/aggregate.py # 离线 OTA 协议检查 python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -v 安全状态 该更新协议尚未被证明是一种可用的恢复机制。 目前的工作尚未针对单 bank 布局建立 ROM 恢复、回滚或安全的中断写入处理机制。 analysis/device/debug-surfaces.md 中的控制台/工厂模式审计未找到替代性的恢复入口。 在使用任何更新或烧写工具之前，请先阅读 TODO_aug2.md。

sents.en: Current work has not established ROM recovery, rollback, or safe interrupted-write behavior for the single-bank layout.
sents.zh: 目前的工作尚未针对单 bank 布局建立 ROM 恢复、回滚或安全的中断写入处理机制。
